items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: I have one granddaughter, in fact it’s her birthday soon. She’s a great drummer.

ctx.x: I have one granddaughter, in fact it’s her birthday soon. She’s a great drummer.
I just wondered sometimes, like your children or your grandchildren, what do they think about what grandma does for a living?
